name: 30241-decode-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B -- bf16, 8.19e9 parameters, ~16.4 GB of weights. Public and ungated.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Dense decoder, Qwen3ForCausalLM: 36 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 151936, rope_theta 1000000, max_position_embeddings 40960, untied embeddings -- all read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 1280 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 15% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, prompt EXACTLY 256 tokens and output EXACTLY 256 (min = max on both), greedy (temperature 0). The backend forces ignore_eos=True whenever max_tokens is set, so all 256 output tokens are always generated. It also renders the prompt into a {"role":"user"} message and applies the Qwen3 chat template, so the engine sees roughly a dozen tokens more than the declared 256.
purpose: A general chat assistant on an 8-billion-parameter model, serving 64 concurrent users short prompts and long replies on one GPU.
launch:
# A stock single-GPU serve of an 8B dense chat model with the attention backend pinned.
# vLLM 0.13.0-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
attention-config: {"backend": "FLASHINFER"}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
